title: Rotate Array to the Right
description: Given an integer array nums, rotate the array to the right by k steps, where k is non-negative. Return the resulting array.
constraints: k may be greater than nums.length, in which case it wraps around

examples.explanation: Rotating the array to the right by 3 steps gives this result.
Rotating the array to the right by 2 steps gives this result.

title: Move Zeroes to End
description: Given an integer array nums, move all 0's to the end of it while maintaining the relative order of the non-zero elements. Return the resulting array.
constraints: The relative order of non-zero elements must be preserved
Zeros must appear at the end of the array

examples.explanation: All non-zero elements keep their relative order, and zeros are moved to the end.
A single zero remains as is.

title: Maximum Subarray Sum
description: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) which has the largest sum, and return that sum.
constraints: The array must contain at least one element

examples.explanation: The subarray [4, -1, 2, 1] has the largest sum, which is 6.
There is only one element, so the maximum sum is 1.

title: Missing Number in Range
description: Given an array nums containing n distinct numbers in the range [0, n], return the only number in the range that is missing from the array.
constraints: All the numbers of nums are unique

examples.explanation: n = 3, so the range is [0,3]. The number 2 is missing from the array.
n = 2, so the range is [0,2]. The number 2 is missing from the array.

title: Find All Duplicates in Array
description: Given an integer array nums where each integer appears either once or twice, return an array of all the integers that appear twice, sorted in ascending order.
constraints: Each element appears either once or twice
The result must be sorted in ascending order

examples.explanation: The numbers 2 and 3 each appear twice in the array.
